description: Create ChatEngine.lua - the main script with samp.events interception, mimgui chat window rendering, filter tabs, auto-hide, config panel, and commands
steps: Safe library loading: require 'mimgui' as imgui, pcall require 'samp.events' as sampev, require 'inicfg', require local 'chatengine_lib' with pcall
DPI scaling: local DPI_SCALE = MONET_DPI_SCALE or 1.0
Config system with inicfg: default structure = { Settings = { enabled=true, fontSize=14, opacity=0.85, autoHideDelay=10, showTimestamp=true } }. Load/save with inicfg.load/save.

State variables: chatInterceptEnabled (bool, default true), lastMessageTime (for auto-hide), currentFilter ('ALL','PM','SERVER','IC','OOC'), showChatWindow (bool), showConfigWindow (imgui.new.bool(false)), chatMinimized (bool)

samp.events hooks: sampev.onServerMessage(color, text) - if chatInterceptEnabled then add message to chatengine_lib buffer with color/text/timestamp, update lastMessageTime, return false to block. sampev.onChatMessage(playerId, text) - same pattern, format with player name if available.
Auto-hide logic: track lastMessageTime = os.clock(). Chat visible = (os.clock() - lastMessageTime < autoHideDelay) or showChatWindow is forced open. Fade alpha based on time elapsed.
imgui.OnFrame for chat window: condition = chatInterceptEnabled and (time since last message < autoHideDelay or forced visible). Render function with self.HideCursor = true.

Chat window UI rendering: SetNextWindowPos top-left (10*DPI, 10*DPI). SetNextWindowSize(screenW*0.45, screenH*0.35). PushStyleVarFloat for WindowRounding(8*DPI). PushStyleVarVec2 for WindowPadding. PushStyleColor for dark theme (WindowBg, ChildBg, Button colors). imgui.Begin with NoResize+NoMove+NoScrollbar+NoTitleBar flags.
Header bar: Draw 'ChatEngine' title text + minimize button (small 'X' or '_' button aligned right). Handle minimize toggle.
Filter tabs row: Render buttons [ALL] [PM] [SERVER] [IC] [OOC] using imgui.Button with PushStyleColor for active tab highlight. On click set currentFilter.

Message area: imgui.BeginChild('##chatmessages', size, border, scrollflags). Loop through filtered messages from chatengine_lib.getFilteredMessages(currentFilter). For each message: render timestamp with TextColored(dimColor, '[HH:MM]'), then SameLine, then render each color segment with TextColored(segmentColor, segmentText). imgui.EndChild(). Auto-scroll: if new message added, imgui.SetScrollHereY(1.0).
Auto-scroll logic: track message count, when count increases call SetScrollHereY(1.0) at bottom of child window

imgui.OnFrame for config panel: condition = showConfigWindow[0]. Render config window with: toggle on/off checkbox, font size slider (10-24), opacity slider (0.3-1.0), auto-hide delay slider (5-30 seconds), save button calling inicfg.save.

Register commands in main() function: sampRegisterChatCommand('chatcfg', function() showConfigWindow[0] = not showConfigWindow[0] end). sampRegisterChatCommand('ceoff', function() chatInterceptEnabled = not chatInterceptEnabled; sampAddChatMessage notification end).
main() function: wait for isSampAvailable(), register commands, print load message via sampAddChatMessage, while true do wait(100) end loop.
Ensure all imgui.PushStyleColor/PushStyleVar calls have matching Pop calls
Use imgui.WindowFlags constants: NoTitleBar, NoResize, NoMove, NoScrollbar, NoBackground as needed
acceptance_criteria: ChatEngine.lua exists at repo root and has no Lua syntax errors
Uses PushStyleVarFloat for float style vars and PushStyleVarVec2 for vec2 style vars (NOT generic PushStyleVar)
samp.events onServerMessage hook blocks default chat with return false when intercept enabled
samp.events onChatMessage hook also intercepts player chat messages
Chat window renders at top-left with semi-transparent dark background
Filter tabs (ALL, PM, SERVER, IC, OOC) correctly filter displayed messages
Auto-hide fades chat after configurable delay (default 10s)
/ceoff command toggles interception on/off as safety fallback
No usage of convert3DCoordsToScreen, addEventHandler('onWindowMessage'), isKeyDown, or sampAddChatMessage for rendering
verification: Run lua syntax check on ChatEngine.lua to verify no syntax errors
Verify both files can be parsed together without reference errors in the module interface
